title: ClearCut
description: Project ClearCut aims to make minecraft as pleasant as possible while staying client-sided
body:
# ClearCut

You want Minecraft to look absolutely stunning, but you also want to actually play it. That’s what ClearCut does.

Built on Fabric, this purely client-side modpack transforms the vanilla experience. You can load it up and jump straight into your favorite server or Realm. It pairs high-end graphics with aggressive optimization, targeting mid-range PCs so you get beautiful lighting and a playable framerate at the same time.

## Visuals & Performance
We are using Complementary Shaders combined with Euphoria Patches. Expect vibrant colors, dense volumetric fog, and incredible water reflections. Rendering all that usually kills your FPS. To fix that, ClearCut runs a highly optimized core featuring Sodium and Lithium.

The standout feature here is Voxy. Voxy generates Level of Detail (LOD) chunks. This lets you crank up your view distance and see mountains miles away without your CPU melting down.

**Heads up:** Because of the visual upgrades, this won't run smoothly on a potato. A decent mid-tier rig is required to push these graphics.

## Sound & Quality of Life
Gorgeous graphics feel cheap if the audio falls flat. Included sound overhauls add realistic physical acoustics. Caverns echo. Deep caves sound hollow. Footsteps crunch differently depending on the exact block you step on.

**We also fixed the clunkiest parts of the base game:**
-     Inventory Management: Mouse Tweaks lets you drag, drop, and sort through messy chests in seconds.
-     Camera Controls: Better Third Person gives you a functional, over-the-shoulder view that actually works for combat and building.
-     Couch Gaming: Full, plug-and-play controller support is baked right in.
## 
## Quick Feature Breakdown

-     100% Client-Side: Play on any vanilla server without issues.
-     High-End Graphics: Complementary Shaders + Euphoria Patches configured out of the box.
-     Massive Render Distances: Voxy brings high-performance LODs.
-     Optimized Core: Sodium, Lithium, and standard Fabric performance boosters.
-     Immersive Audio: Complete sound overhauls for realistic acoustics.
-     Modern QoL: Controller support, better cameras, and fast inventory sorting.
